errors.evidence: The chart shows stacked bars (натрупани), not grouped bars (групирани).

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Неравенство в разпределението на доходите“
errors.evidence: The vertical axis has no label in the figure.

errors.text_span: показва стойности, простиращи се от приблизително 25 до приблизително 50 единици
errors.evidence: This describes the approximate range of the total bar heights, not the range of the axis itself, which starts from 0.

errors.text_span: светло зелено за 2017, жълто за 2018, оранжево за 2019 и червено за 2020
errors.evidence: The color descriptions are incorrect. According to the legend, 2017 is blue, 2018 is brown, 2019 is grey, and 2020 is yellow.

errors.text_span: Всяка страна е представена от пет стълба
errors.evidence: Each country is represented by a single stacked bar composed of five segments, not five separate bars.

errors.text_span: страните са подредени според азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The countries are not ordered alphabetically. They are sorted in ascending order based on the total height of their respective bars.
No bars in the chart are shaded. The 2019 data series is colored grey, but this is a solid color, not shading, and it is a segment, not a whole bar.
The description incorrectly states there is no clear order, when the bars are clearly sorted in ascending order of their total value from left to right.
